environment.description: ECS Fargate service running Node.js 18 container behind an Application Load Balancer. Task definition uses awsvpc networking mode with public IP assignment. ALB forwards all traffic on port 443 to target group on port 3000. No additional response header modifications configured. Service runs in a public subnet with internet-facing ALB. Container image: node:18-slim. Task role has read/write access to RDS PostgreSQL instance.
